title: The Sprite Whisperer
subtitle: How to find all the new Trick or Treat Sprites, fast
version_note: Chapter 7 Season 4 (Override), Fortnitemares update v42.30. Based on a creator's video guide; facts checked 15 October 2026.
description: An unofficial Fortnite fan book that turns a YouTube creator's Trick or Treat Sprite hunting strategy into a step-by-step guide.
glossary_blurb: Every Word Watch word in this book, from A to Z. A true Sprite Whisperer collects words as well as Sprites. Try to use three of these before the weekend.
